description.en: A tikbalang leads some workers astray. Answer its riddle and they find their way home at once.
description.fil: Inililigaw ng tikbalang ang ilang manggagawa. Sagutin ang bugtong nito at makauuwi sila agad.

question.en: When it is rolled up, it is small; when it is spread out, it is wide. What is it?
question.fil: Kung bilutin ay maliit, kung iladlad ay malapad. Ano ito?

question.en: I follow you everywhere, but I am never caught. What am I?
question.fil: Sumusunod saan ka man, ngunit hindi mahuli kailanman. Ano ako?

question.en: It has many joints but cannot walk; it sways but has no legs. What is it?
question.fil: Maraming buko ngunit hindi lumalakad, umuugoy ngunit walang paa. Ano ito?

sources: Maximo D. Ramos, The Creatures of Philippine Lower Mythology (University of the Philippines Press, 1971)
Damiana L. Eugenio, Philippine Folk Literature: The Riddles (University of the Philippines Press, 1994)
